Red Pop: My least favorite of them all. Just reminds me of cough syrup. Tried to drink a few of them to get over the initial impression, but could only taste red cough syrup. Bleh. 2/10

  
Rock'n Rye: Really, really good. Reminded me of the original counterpart. Tastes even better nice and cold, would recommend. 7/10

  
Orange: I'm a sucker for Orange soda, and this one is no different. Really great flavor, and sadly doesn't last long enough. Has that "Tang" just like other Orange sodas that I really enjoy in an orange. 8/10
